claims.statement: Managed processes have active states created/starting/running/ready/stopping/restarting and terminal states exited/failed/killed/lost/reaped, with stop modes graceful/force sourced from agent, user, host, or main (src/contract/processes.ts).

ManagedProcessService (src/agent-host/managed-process/service.ts) owns managed process records and enforces MANAGED_PROCESS_LIMITS from src/shared/managed-process-policy.ts including per-session and global active caps, sizing limits, stdin cap, exited-record retention, and wait window bounds.
Managed process starts are rate-limited (START_RATE_LIMIT within a rolling start window) in ManagedProcessService.

validateManagedProcessCommand (src/shared/managed-process-policy.ts) blocks commands that would escape containment such as nohup/disown/setsid/daemonize, systemd-run, runas, external terminals, background shell control, and Windows service creation.

The Posix backend (posix-backend.ts) spawns a dedicated worker process (managed-process-worker.mjs) that runs the shell, streams events back, signals the process group on stop, and tracks getProcessStartFingerprint.

The Windows backend (windows-helper-client.ts) uses a native Rust helper (native/windows-managed-process-helper/src/main.rs) that creates a Windows Job object with a completion port to contain the whole process tree, streams length-prefixed frames, and requires parent identity proof (PID, start time, image path).

Process output is buffered in a bounded ring and read via processes.read/processes.wait returning ManagedProcessLogWindow slices; loopback endpoints are extracted from stdout/stderr and stored (max 8).
processes.read/processes.wait can await a readiness condition with a default 10s / max 30s window.

The main process runs ManagedProcessReaper (src/main/managed-process/reaper.ts) backed by a durable v2 JSON journal (max 16 records, 64 KB) whose directory is checked for unsafe permissions; records created by the Host are registered before they matter.

The reaper is not ready unless the platform is supported and (on Windows) a helper descriptor or reapWindows callback is present; capability.ts combines reaper readiness with the Host's managed-process owner acknowledgement to compute the ManagedProcessCapability.

cleanupManagedProcessContainment (shutdown-cleanup.ts) stStops the Host and reaps records within one deadline and fails closed unless the Host stopped, the reaper completed, and the reaper status is ready with zero records.
